name: Example: Finding the Characteristic Equation of a Matrix
problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14068962/assets/901d3a22065b48a8076b9c9aae5563c770c36c9ad40e4063c0f739847e1cda98.png)
worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\, A-\lambda I\mathbin{:}$
﻿﻿﻿![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14068962/assets/0c6f9f860a1cf4d510f6c3d4d9c66b77496a354bb1e2cef1b69fd1178e4f15ab.png)

Then, the characteristic equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 4 \\ 3 & 2-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (2-\lambda )(2-\lambda )-4\cdot 3 & =0 \\ 4-4\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}-12 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}-4\lambda -8 & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
